title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.

title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer (Stealth Healthcare AI Startup)
description:
Who we are

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

We're looking for an engineer to help build our core platform end-to-end: backend services, data flows, infrastructure, and modern frontends. You’ll work directly with founders to shape architecture, ship features fast, and turn complex healthcare workflows into intuitive products.


What you'll do

  • Build and evolve full-stack platform components (backend, pipelines, frontend)
  • Develop AI-driven features for clinical and financial data
  • Architect scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS
  • Implement clean, observable data flows for ML/LLMs
  • Ship features from 0→1 and influence product direction


Must-have Skills

  • Strong programming skills (any modern language)
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
  • Experience building platform or product from scratch
  • SQL + data modeling
  • Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
  • Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownership


Nice-to-haves

  • Go or Python
  • Clean architecture / DDD
  • AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
  • Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
  • HIPAA / PHI security
  • HL7/FHIR/X12


Why join us

  • Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
  • Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
  • Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
  • Flexible, modern work environment


If you're excited about leveraging AI to solve complex healthcare challenges and building technology that makes a real difference for providers and patients, we want to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor Júnior (Microsoft Power Platform)
description:
Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento ou afins;
  • Inglês Básico.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Power BI, Power Automate e Power App;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software Web e banco de dados;
  • Experiência em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Habilidades em Python, JavaScript, React, html5, CSS3, construção de API e microserviços;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Programação de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power BI / Power Platform, bem como as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS .


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Modelagem de dados e estatística.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na identificação dos requisitos, design e implantação da solução;
  • Criar fluxos automatizados entre aplicações e serviços utilizando o Microsoft Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate e Power Pages;
  • Desenvolver e manter Dashboards no Microsoft Power BI;
  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações robustas e escaláveis usando .NET Framework e .NET Core e aplicativos nativos em Flutter.

• Garantir a conformidade dos designs de software com as especificações técnicas e requisitos de negócios.

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software.

• Participar da elaboração de propostas de solução técnica e estimativa de desenvolvimento para elaboração de propostas comerciais.

• Documentar de processos e comunicação de progresso para stakeholders.

- ANDROID

- FLUTTER

- Android Studio

- iOS Design

- iOS development

- Desenvolvimento para iOS

- Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Android

- Java Android

- .NET Framework, SQL Server, MVC, DDD, Unit Tests, API REST, Azure Devops, Azure Cloud.

- .NET (FRAMEWORK E CORE)

- ADVANCED TROUBLESHOOTING


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Mission

  • Responsible for building, managing, and optimizing data pipelines;
  • Support for defining data flows and access to data sources;
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, data architecture, and data security requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and optimize data pipelines for data structures that encompass data modeling, data transformation, schemas, metadata, and workload management;
  • Drive Automation through effective metadata management;
  • Participate in ensuring compliance and governance during data use, including the maintenance of the data catalog;
  • Collaborate and support data owners and other stakeholders around data topics;
  • Ensure the proper use of the data architecture defined by Data Factory team;
  • Respect and follow security principles ensuring compliance with data delivery.


Competencies & Skills

  • Strong experience with various Data Management architectures, mainly AWS environment;
  • Strong experience with Data Modeling;
  • Ability to design, build and manage data pipelines;
  • Experience working with commercial and open source message queuing technologies;
  • Highly creative and collaborative;
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.


Specific Technical Knowledge

  • Solid knowledge in: Databrics, Spark, python, terraform, SQL, Scala, S3, AWS Glue, AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions; Big data, Relational Databases;
  • Experience in: EMR, Gitflow, Agile Metodology; DevOps.


Languages

  • English: Advanced or Fluent


Additional information

  • Remote work

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno

Requisitos Obrigatórios

- Experiência com desenvolvimento em Salesforce, com proficiência na criação de classes Apex, triggers, tratamento de exceções e testes unitários

- É necessário ter experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC) ou Aura, além de conhecimento em integrações via API REST/SOAP

- Familiaridade com o uso de Apex assíncrono, incluindo Batch, Queueable e Future, é essencial

- É importante ter experiência no uso de Git para versionamento de código e conhecimentos no ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento e deployments, como change sets ou CI/CD

- Deverá ter habilidades em ferramentas declarativas, incluindo Flow, criação de objetos, campos, tipos de registro e layouts de página.

- Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita é requerido.

- Certificação Salesforce Platform Developer I é um diferencial, assim como experiência com integração de modelos de Inteligência Artificial via API

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e capacidade de trabalhar de maneira colaborativa com outros times para entender requisitos e propor soluções escaláveis são desejáveis

- Habilidade em resolver problemas complexos e perfil autodidata com iniciativa para aprender por conta própria serão valorizados.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.

title: ML/Data Science Lead
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Science Lead will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Lead will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 10 years in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Business/Function Analysts
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Business/Function Analysts , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The IT Business/Functional Analyst plays a critical role in bridging business needs with technological solutions. The primary function is to analyze and interpret business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that technology solutions are aligned with the company's objectives. This role requires working closely with business users, developers, and project managers to deliver effective technology solutions that enhance business processes and improve efficiency.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Analysis and Specification: Conduct in-depth analysis of business requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications for the development team. Create wireframes and mockups to visualize the proposed solutions.
  • Solution Design and Testing: Collaborating with developers and system architects to design solutions that meet business needs. Develop and execute test plans and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Stakeholder Management and Leadership: Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Lead and coordinate project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed on time.
  • Risk Management and Budgeting: Identify and mitigate risks in technology projects. Assist in managing project budgets and ensure the use of resources in a cost-effective manner.
  • Documentation and Support: Create comprehensive user documentation and training materials. Provide ongoing technical support for implemented solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze and resolve system problems and incidents. Participate in change management to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience as a business or functional analyst in an IT environment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Languages: Advanced English and/or French.



Tools and Abilities:

  • Proficiency in business analytics tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio .
  • Experience with project management software such as Jira, Trello, Microsoft Project, and Asana .
  • Knowledge in SQL and experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL.
  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies , including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall .
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and CRM systems such as Salesforce .

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and lead project activities.
  • Leadership: Proven experience in project and team management, with the ability to mentor junior team members.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.
  • Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified ScrumMaster .
  • Knowledge: Experience in specific industries such as finance, healthcare, or manufacturing. Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python, Java or C# .

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As the JAVA Engineering Team Lead , you will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of talented developers, overseeing the development and maintenance of our Java-based gaming platform. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions. Your role will involve a combination of hands-on development, technical leadership, and strategic planning.


The impact you will have:


  • You will be responsible for leading, motivating, and developing a team of engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • You will oversee the complete development cycle of the Java gaming platform, ensuring quality, security, and best practices.
  • You will collaborate with managers and principal engineers in defining requirements, deadlines, and strategic technical decisions.
  • You will be required to monitor project progress, remove blockers, and ensure timely deliveries aligned with business objectives.
  • You will also participate in code review, complex troubleshooting, and the promotion of continuous improvement for the team and its processes.


What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, Agile methodologies, and DevOps tools.
  • Advanced English.
  • Good communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills are essential.
  • Knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Micronaut) and SQL databases is also valued.
  • This role is Remote based in Brazil.





Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O(A) Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby será responsável por:

Implementação de Soluções

  • Escrever e implementar código conforme requisitos.
  • Garantir qualidade e usabilidade do produto.
  • Testar e depurar em diferentes ambientes.
  • Contribuir em decisões de arquitetura e design.
  • Revisar código para manter padrões de qualidade.
  • Integrar componentes de software.
  • Estimar tarefas junto ao Líder Técnico e PM, utilizando métricas da equipe.


Sustentação dos Sistemas

  • Resolver chamados (erros e dúvidas).
  • Executar scripts e relatórios de apoio.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados com apoio e revisão dos líderes e pares.
  • Participar de war rooms com TL e/ou PM.
  • Atuar pela estabilidade do sistema com SRE e TL, respondendo a alertas e prevenindo falhas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Proficiência em ActiveRecord, ActionCable, ActionMailer e background jobs.
  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.
  • Práticas de testes automatizados (RSpec, Minitest, FactoryBot, etc.).


Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas, guidelines e processos que facilitem o trabalho do time de desenvolvimento SAP.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento ABAP, incluindo:
  • ABAP OO (Object-Oriented ABAP)
  • BAdIs e Enhancement Framework
  • BRF+
  • CDS Views
  • OData e APIs RESTful
  • SAP Fiori/UI5
  • Conceitos de Clean Core e práticas de extensibilidade SAP

  • RAP (Restful ABAP Programming) — CDS, Annotations, Behavior Definitions, Managed/Unmanaged Implementation, EML
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) e Business Application Studio (BAS)
  • Conhecimento de Solution Manager (ChaRM, Focused Build)
  • Conhecimento em SAP Master Data Governance (MDG):
  • Modelagem de dados e frameworks de governança
  • INGLÊS AVANÇADO/FLUENTE


  • Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em qualidade técnica

title: .Net Developer - Pleno
description:
.Net Developer - Pleno


REST API Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable RESTful APIs using the .NET stack (.NET Framework, .NET Core).

Working with Azure Environments: Implement and manage applications in Azure environments, leveraging cloud services to optimize performance and scalability.

Clean Architecture: Apply clean architecture principles to ensure code is modular, testable, and easy to maintain.

Event-Driven Applications or Microservices Development: Design and implement event-driven systems or microservices, ensuring components are decoupled and can be scaled independently.

Relational Database Management: Work with relational databases like SQL Server and Postgres, including schema design, query optimization, and data integrity maintenance.

Use of Docker/Kubernetes: Utilize Docker for application containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration, facilitating consistent development, testing, and deployment.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with frontend, design, and product teams to ensure business requirements are effectively met.

Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for improvement in code and development processes, promoting agile development and DevOps practices.

Security and Compliance: Ensure applications are secure and comply with relevant standards and regulations.


Requirements


  • Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of .NET Framework, .NET Core, and RESTful API development. Experience with development environments in Azure.
  • Software Architecture: Ability to apply clean architecture principles to create modular and scalable systems.
  • Microservices Development: Experience in designing and implementing event-driven or microservices-based applications.
  • Database Management: Skill in working with relational databases like SQL Server and Postgres, including design and query optimization.
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Knowledge of Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for application orchestration.
  • Leadership and Mentoring: Ability to provide technical leadership and mentor junior developers, fostering team growth.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Skill in effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clearly communicating technical ideas.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical ability to identify and solve complex software problems.
  • Security and Compliance: Knowledge of software security practices and compliance with standards and regulations.


Skill Set

title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

title: Sr Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos;
  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.


Diferencias:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos/front-end com React Native e React;
  • Experiência com Javascript/Typescript;
  • Experiencia com Next.js, React Hooks, Styled Components, Axios;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Microfrontend (MFE)


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net CORE Sênior
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Core Sênior


Descrição da Vaga


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend .NET Core , para atuar em projetos de arquitetura moderna, utilizando microsserviços , mensageria e entrega contínua . A pessoa será responsável por desenvolver, testar e evoluir APIs escaláveis e performáticas, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code , DDD (Domain Driven Design) e desenvolvimento orientado a objetos .

O ambiente de trabalho adota metodologias ágeis , com forte colaboração entre times multidisciplinares, e foco em qualidade, automação e melhoria contínua .


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e microsserviços utilizando .NET Core (.NET 8) ;
  • Aplicar princípios de DDD , orientação a objetos e Clean Code ;
  • Implementar soluções com mediator pattern , mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Trabalhar com ORMs (Entity Framework, Dapper) para integração com bancos SQL e NoSQL ;
  • Criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração);
  • Contribuir para pipeline de entrega contínua (CI/CD) e práticas de feature toggle ;
  • Colaborar com times ágeis em um ambiente Kanban/Scrum ;
  • Participar de revisões de código e discussões de arquitetura;
  • Apoiar a evolução das práticas de engenharia e qualidade de software.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com .NET Core (preferencialmente .NET 8 );
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e testes de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em orientação a objetos e DDD ;
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microsserviços ;
  • Experiência com mensageria e comunicação assíncrona ;
  • Experiência com bancos SQL (e desejável NoSQL);
  • Experiência com ORMs (Entity Framework e/ou Dapper);
  • Experiência com Mediator Pattern ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e desenvolvimento com containers;
  • Experiência com entrega contínua (CI/CD) e feature toggle ;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e colaboração com múltiplos times.


Desejável

  • Conhecimento em TDD e BDD ;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes ;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure ;
  • Familiaridade com Kanban ;
  • Interesse em práticas de DevOps e automação de deploy.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Analista de Monitoramento/BI
description:
Analista de Monitoramento e BI Sênior


Irá atuar tanto em BI quanto em monitoramento, atuando de forma mais técnica para apoiar automações e melhorias de processos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Monitoramento e análise aprofundada durante o horário comercial.
  • Identificação e classificação de temas sensíveis.
  • Desenvolvimento de automação de processos (dashboards, relatórios dinâmicos, alertas automáticos).
  • Gestão da interface técnica e metodológica com o parceiro externo.
  • Elaboração de relatórios de performance e recomendações estratégicas.


Perfil desejado:

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de monitoramento (Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Stilingue e etc.).
  • Habilidade em automação de dados e visualização (Power BI, Python básico, Big Query e integrações via API).
  • Perfil analítico, com visão estratégica e capacidade de traduzir dados em insights de negócio.


Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Assistência Médica;

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Propulsion System Network Engineer to be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and overall management of propulsion system communication files (CAN, LDF). This role will be critical in supporting root cause analysis, problem resolution, and the administration of our Propulsion Networking Process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain propulsion system communication files (CAN, LDF) in accordance with project requirements.
  • Support root cause analysis and problem resolution related to propulsion network communication.
  • Administer and improve the Propulsion Networking Process.
  • Manage document releases, ensuring alignment with project milestones.
  • Ensure conformity and quality in file generation processes.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering counterparts, including Chief Engineers, COE Leads, and System Engineers.
  • Work with the Simulation team to integrate network data into simulation environments.
  • Interface and coordinate with Electrical Engineering (EE) Networking teams across all regions regarding production and prototype CAN/LIN file development.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Applied Physics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or related Engineering field from an ABET accredited university
  • Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience with Controller Area Network (CAN)/LIN communication systems development and standards
  • Experience with Propulsion System communication architectures and controllers
  • Working experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, Notepad ++ and PowerPoint
  • Highly motivated/self-starter with proven leadership skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment
  • Trained in the Agile Methodology
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills
  • Good understanding of CAN/LIN interfaces


Technical Tool Skills:

  • MATLAB/SIMULINK/STATEFLOW
  • Vector CANalyzer, CANoe
  • IBM Rational DOORS
  • Decent knowledge of CAN/LIN

title: Engenheiro DevOps Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

· Deverá assumir a função de Engenheiro Devops em projetos internos e externos;

· Terá a responsabilidade de participar junto com a equipe de arquitetura de solução e de infraestrutura na definição das soluções tecnológicas nos âmbitos dos processos de CI/CD, orquestração de containers em Cloud e onPremise e monitoramento e observabilidade.

· Atuará no provisionamento e ativação de infraestrutura e/ou componentes de cloud, configuração de pipelines de build e deploy, instalação e configuração de componentes de gestão e orquestração de contêineres, instalação e manutenção de certificados TLS/SSL, instalação e configuração de ferramentas e dashboards de observabilidade e monitoramento.


Requisitos técnicos:

· Inglês Intermediário - Leitura e escrita;

· Experiência profunda em orquestração de microserviços usando Docker, Kubernetes ou OpenShift em Cloud e OnPremise.

· Conhecimento em aplicação, gestão e configuração de certificados TLS/SSL em ambiente de microserviços.

· Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e desenvolvimento de software.

· Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura como Chef, Ansible e Terraform;

· Profundo conhecimento em ferramentas e processos de integração e deploy (CI/CD) em pelo menos duas das seguintes ferramentas: Azure Devops Pipelines, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Bitbucket Pipelines,

· Experiência em colaboração com equipe de arquitetura de integração de solução onPremise e Cloud na definição dos padrões, tecnologias e infraestrutura necessários com base nos objetivos de negócio;

· Conhecimento profundo em shell script e bash;

· Conhecimento de configuração de ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (Grafana, ELK, Zabbix, Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, NewRelic, etc)

· Adaptabilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente multi tecnológico.

· Experiência em ambiente cloud (AWS ou Azure ou GCP)

· Experiência em trouble shooting de ambiente aplicacional. Compreendendo análise de problemas junto com equipe de desenvolvimento e suporte.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Desenvolvedor (a) JAVA SR
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Requisitos :

Experiência em Java (JDK 8+), Spring Boot, Hibernate e multithreading.

SQL e Gerenciamento de Banco de Dados – o Sólido conhecimento de SQL, bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) e técnicas de otimização.

Microsserviços e Desenvolvimento de APIs – o Experiência em design de APIs RESTful e trabalho com arquitetura de microsserviços.

Otimização de Desempenho – o Proficiência em indexação de banco de dados, otimização de consultas, cache (Redis, Memcached) e ajuste de JVM.

Nuvem e DevOps – o Familiaridade com plataformas de nuvem (Azure), pipelines de CI/CD e conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Segurança e Boas Práticas – o Compreensão de autenticação (OAuth, JWT), criptografia e práticas de codificação segura.

Design de Sistemas e Escalabilidade – o Conhecimento de sistemas distribuídos, filas de mensagens e arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade.

Liderança e Colaboração de Equipes – o Experiência em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, promovendo a colaboração entre Desenvolvimento, Operações e Garantia da Qualidade.

Controle de versão – Experiência sólida com comandos Git (clone, commit, push, pull, branching) e trabalho com repositórios no GitHub/GitLab/BitBucket.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Business Analyst who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Experience as a BA in mobility projects and/or system integration.

Knowledge of agile methods and management tools (Jira, Azure Boards).

Ability to create test cases and validate functional requirements.

Advanced English.

Agile Methodology (Scrum)

Will work on eliciting and documenting requirements, mapping processes, and defining acceptance criteria, also taking on the QA role in the final phase to ensure that the delivery meets business requirements.

Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into user stories and acceptance criteria.

Map the delivery and invoice processing flow, integrating entry points (app) and output (EDI). Document integrations, data formats, and business rules. Define metrics and success criteria for the PoC.

Create test cases and perform functional validation in the final phase. Report defects and follow up on corrections with the technical team.

Jira
